title: Book Three · Chapter 154: The City Beside the Sea
story:
On Thursday of the first holiday week, Ronan visits the library.

He has finished the first part of his school work. Now he wants to look beyond the short local course.

The librarian finds a folder of practical study. Ronan carries it to a table near the map shelf.

One centre offers a year of business and work training. It is in a coastal city.

Ronan reads the little list beneath the picture: customer messages, office work, numbers, and English.

There are lessons and practice in local businesses. He looks at the picture of two students beside a desk. One is writing. The other is talking to a man with a parcel.

Ronan finds a map and opens it beside the folder.

He marks Leo's city first. Then he finds the city on Anna's visitor sheet. The new centre is in a third city, beside the sea.

He follows the coast with his finger. He has never seen the sea.

For a moment, he looks only at the long blue edge. Then he turns back to the class list.

The picture shows students at a desk. The map shows the whole city as one small mark.

He leans closer, looking for the centre. This map has no streets to follow. He cannot use it to find a door.

Ronan takes a clean sheet and writes the three city names on it. He puts the course name beside the coastal one.

Leo has a place at his aunt's home. Anna has seen a room for students. Ronan has only the little printed picture.

He looks at the list of subjects again.

At Mr Sun's, he could ask Dad or the owner about a customer paper. A new city has new people. He needs to ask them for help himself.

That thought makes him sit straighter. He is curious and uneasy at the same time.

He reads the address under the picture from beginning to end. There is enough information to send a letter. There is not enough yet to pack a bag and go.

“Can I copy this address?” he asks the librarian.

“Of course.”

He copies it carefully and writes three questions below. What does the year include? What does it cost? How does the practice work?

At home, he puts those questions in a short letter to the centre. He gives his return address and posts it that afternoon. The stamp comes from his separate spending money.

On his way back, he stops at the workshop. Dad is measuring near the front. Mr Sun asks about the folder under Ronan's arm.

“A copy from the library,” Ronan says.

He shows Mr Sun the centre's address.

Mr Sun looks at it for a moment.

“One of our former helpers studies there. He is home for the holiday.”

Ronan looks up.

“Could I ask him about it?”

“He is coming here on Monday in the third holiday week. You can talk if he has time.”

Ronan thanks him and writes the day beside his questions.

Dad looks at the city name.

“A long way.”

“I need more than the picture.”

Dad nods. He turns the paper so the light falls across the small print.

“Start with these lines.”

They read the subjects together. At English, Dad gives Ronan a small smile.

“You may know that part before me.”

“Some of it.”

Ronan folds the copy and puts it in his bag. Outside, he stops beside the public map board and finds the long coast once more before he walks home.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

coastal＝沿海的；business＝商业、商务；former＝以前的；subject＝学习科目。

## 理解问题

1. 新培训城市与Leo所在城、Anna参观城是同一个地方吗？Ronan实际查了什么？
2. 他向中心寄出了哪几类问题？还能向谁了解真实学习生活？

## 读句子

**He follows the coast with his finger.**

拆开看：He / follows the coast / with his finger.

他／沿着海岸线看过去／用手指在地图上指着。
